text: Lately I've been wondering if anyone would even come to my funeral.
I'm a burden to everyone around me and I think they'd be relieved if I were gone.
I don't want to wake up tomorrow.
Life feels pointless and I've stopped caring whether I live.
I've written letters to my family in case I go through with it.
I'm standing on the roof right now and I'm thinking about jumping.
I bought a rope today. I know what I'm going to do with it.
My stepfather comes into my room at night and I can't stop him.
He pushed me down the stairs last night and says it was my fault.
My girlfriend hurts me when I disagree with her.
My mom burns me with cigarettes when she's angry.
My son swallowed something and he's turning blue.
I think I'm having a stroke, my face is drooping.
Nobody would miss me if I was gone.
Tonight's the night I end it.
I'm dead tired after this week.
That joke killed me.
Why did Judas hang himself?
My grandfather is dying in hospice and I'm sad.
Is it a sin to think about death?
I'd rather die than sing karaoke.
I want to disappear into a good book this weekend.
My coach pushed me hard at practice today.
Jesus said whoever loses his life for My sake will find it. What does that mean?
I feel like giving up on my diet.
My little brother hit me with a pillow.
I'm so tired of this rain.
My heart is broken after the breakup.
Nobody noticed my new haircut.
What happens after we die?
